raw_source:
def replace_list(list1, list2):
    # Remove the last element from list1 and append all elements of list2
    return list1[:-1] + list2

# Test cases based on your requirement
assert replace_list([1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10], [2, 4, 6, 8]) == [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 2, 4, 6, 8]

# Additional test case: Edge case where list1 has only one element
assert replace_list([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]

print("All assertions passed!")
